summary: Org-wide Okta deprovisioning race causes token revocation blocking CLI/service-runner logins
description:
Issue summary: During an org-wide deprovisioning job (safety cleanup for inactive contractors) we observed a race between Okta session revocation and our token re-issuance path. This caused a subset of ephemeral CLI tokens and long-running service-runner sessions to be rejected, preventing internal tooling authentication for affected users and automated jobs.

Impact: ~120 developer CLI sessions errored with 401/403 in us-east and eu-west; several nightly model-eval runners failed to start. No customer-facing inference endpoints were affected.

Business impact: internal dev velocity degraded, delayed nightly evaluations and blocked a small on-call escalation workflow.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Ensure user has an active long-lived CLI session (issued >12h ago) and a service-runner job with token refresh configured.
2) Trigger the scheduled Okta deprovisioning job that revokes sessions for users marked inactive in LDAP (internal cron: identity-sync/deprovision/weekly).
3) Immediately attempt an API call with the existing CLI token or perform token refresh for the service-runner.
4) Observe auth failures (401 / 403) even though user shows as active in our local cache for a short window prior to sync completion.
observed_behavior: Tokens that were issued prior to Okta deprovisioning are intermittently rejected during the deprovisioning window. Identity-proxy logs show a short window where our cache still returns the old user state but Okta responds 'revoked' to introspection calls, leading to a race and final rejection. Some retries succeed after ~30s when caches reconcile.
expected_behavior: Either a graceful transitional state where existing sessions remain valid until rotated OR near-immediate propagation with consistent revocation across our token introspection and session caches so clients receive deterministic responses.
logs: 2026-03-10T02:04:12Z identity-proxy[auth-introspect] INFO token_introspect user=svc-runner-27 token_id=abc123 status=active
2026-03-10T02:04:13Z okta-sync INFO deprovision: start batch=contractors-20260310 count=187
2026-03-10T02:04:13Z okta API DEBUG introspect token=abc123 response=status=revoked code=401
2026-03-10T02:04:13Z identity-proxy WARN reconcile mismatch token=abc123 cache_state=active okta_state=revoked
2026-03-10T02:04:13Z cli-client ERROR api_request user=bob@example.com error=401 Unauthorized
investigation_notes: Initial triage (Aisha): correlated spike of 401s with scheduled deprovision job at 02:04 UTC.

Hypothesis: identity-sync performs bulk Okta revoke then emits user status events; our identity-proxy uses a short-lived in-memory cache that can respond before the event stream processes the deprovision message, creating a TOCTOU (time-of-check time-of-use) window.
Observed that token introspection calls to Okta return 'revoked' while our local cache still marks session active for ~20-40s.
Reproducible locally by running deprovision job against staging Okta and issuing concurrent token introspection + cache read.
mitigation: Applied an emergency server-side check: identity-proxy now performs an Okta-introspect call when cache indicates active but the token age is >6h OR when a bulk deprovision event is in progress. This reduces false-positives for invalid active-state responses. Deployed hotfix to prod at 2026-03-11T18:10Z.
resolution: Ongoing. Hotfix reduces rate of failures by ~95% in short term. A durable fix (see follow-up tasks) will change event ordering and add a coordinated revocation phase to avoid races. Change to be implemented in identity-sync and identity-proxy coordination layer.
follow_up_tasks: 1) Implement coordinated revocation handshake in identity-sync so Okta revokes are gated until identity-proxy acknowledges event sequencing. Owner: Miguel. ETA: 2026-03-19
2) Add canary/deferred-revocation mode to weekly deprovision job to reduce blast radius. Owner: SRE team. ETA: 2026-03-24
3) Improve observability: add metric for 'introspect_mismatch' with labels (region, job_id). Owner: Observability. ETA: 2026-03-14
4) Postmortem and runbook update: document fallback policy and emergency mitigation steps. Owner: Support. ETA: 2026-03-16

2026-03-10T05:22:40Z - Miguel Ortega (SRE): Reproduced in staging. Confirmed TOCTOU race between Okta introspect and local cache. Will assemble quick mitigation.
2026-03-11T18:15:03Z - Miguel Ortega (SRE): Hotfix deployed to identity-proxy to perform introspect for tokens older than 6h or when deprov job in progress. Monitoring impact.
2026-03-11T19:05:27Z - Sophie Lange (Platform Eng): Observability shows 95% reduction in 401s tied to this window. Still seeing rare residuals in eu-west; investigating backlog processing timing.
2026-03-12T09:32:11Z - Aisha Patel (Support): Affected users advised to 'rehydrate' sessions by re-authenticating if they see 401. Support playbook updated with temporary workaround.
2026-03-12T11:00:00Z - Miguel Ortega (SRE): Created PR for coordinated revocation handshake: github.com/redwood-inference/identity-sync/pull/482. Planning review and rollout in two-phase canary.
